logic.description: Requirement logic, acceptance-criteria consistency, and fail-closed reasoning review.
logic.provider_selection_rationale: zcode_glm_5_2 is the default primary; no documented role-specific Kimi superiority exists for logic.

security.description: Security-sensitive behavior, secrets/auth boundaries, unsafe mutation, and fail-closed risk review.
security.provider_selection_rationale: zcode_glm_5_2 is the default primary; Kimi CLI default/latest remains the declared secondary.

arch.description: Project-agnostic architecture, integration, API/schema, modularity, and ownership-boundary review.
arch.provider_selection_rationale: zcode_glm_5_2 is the default primary; arch remains generic unless the reviewed scope is project-specific.

cve.description: Known-vulnerability, dependency-risk, exploitability, and security-advisory relevance review from provided evidence.
cve.provider_selection_rationale: zcode_glm_5_2 is the default primary; no documented role-specific Kimi superiority exists for CVE review.

test_adequacy.description: Test and verification adequacy against the task contract and acceptance criteria.
test_adequacy.provider_selection_rationale: zcode_glm_5_2 is the default primary; Kimi CLI default/latest remains the declared secondary for independent adequacy review.

kimi_default.model_selection_note: Kimi Code CLI uses the authenticated CLI default/latest model in this environment; no stable explicit model alias is configured locally.
